title: 加州有没有恐龙 · 素材

One single sabre-toothed cat standing on four legs, seen from the side facing left, two long teeth hanging down from its upper jaw, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
